subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the first-purchase program for your electronics app, after the earlier notes on confirmed-purchase optimization and where UK acquisition costs are heading. If incremental, return-adjusted orders are on your roadmap this quarter, I can share the category-level purchase view and a short holdout read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it becomes useful.
